q2_gaps: a definite plural group as the subject of a whenever-rule consequent: a distributive predicate on a group normally also requires a per-member PartOf distribution rule, but the instruction set gives that rule no place inside an Implication's conclusion, so each lantern's own producing event is unreachable

"many" as a vague count on an object NP: it appears only in the proportion-to-strength table (many -> 0.7, for quantification over a subject kind) and is absent from the CardinalityPhrase vague-quantity list, so which channel an object-position "many Ns" takes is left unstated
notes: The whenever machinery is applied correctly — indefinite trigger participant as a plain premise variable with its typing conjunct, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, no QuantifierPhrase companion, 1.0/0.9 — as are the Cliff Path name-plus-kind atoms and the Name-only treatment of the capitalized plural label "the Hollows" (no GroupOf, no invented kind). Location for event-side "on" and LocatedIn for entity-side "at" are both the licensed heads.
